comparison_unit: provider/model/API/config bundle; not a pure model comparison

excluded_calibration_generations.description: OpenAI breadth run on pre-fix commit
Groq pre-fix run that exposed AgentLimitError runner bug
Groq post-fix calibration executed with max_tokens=1200

quality_metrics_policy: Quality, grounding, causal, token, latency and trajectory aggregates are calculated only for status=ok cells. Provider failures, rate limits and bound exhaustion are never imputed as zero-quality observations.
statistical_claims: descriptive breadth evidence only; no statistical significance
uncertainty_metric_policy: uncertainty_preserved is treated as lexical uncertainty-language detection, not as proof of correct epistemic posture.
